verdict.rationale: Plausible itself runs a narrow set of user-configured background automations: scheduled weekly or monthly email and Slack reports, plus traffic spike/drop notifications. These are recurring schedules, not one-off actions, but they are fixed report and alert types rather than general automations a user can define. missing for 10: user-definable automation workflows or triggers/actions, agent-driven or programmable scheduled tasks, depth documentation of configuration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Email reports: scheduled reports delivered to your inbox
Get weekly or monthly reports via email or Slack, including traffic spike/drop notifications.
Traffic spike notifications: get alerted when traffic spikes
